questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Schmidt und Herr Müller sprachen von ihrem Bekannten, Herrn Allen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Schmidt and Mr. Müller were speaking of their friend, Mr. Allen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Müller hatte Herrn Allen am Abend zum Zug begleitet.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Müller had accompanied Mr. Allen to the train in the evening.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Leider hatte nicht alles geklappt.

answers.answer_text: Unfortunately not everything had worked out all right.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen war am Nachmittag zu ihm gekommen, nachdem er seine Fahrkarte gelöst hatte.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen had come to his house in the afternoon after he had bought his ticket.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte auch seine vier Koffer zur Gepäckaufgabe gebracht.

answers.answer_text: He had also taken his four suitcases to the baggage checkroom.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Erst als er bei seinem Bekannten war, fiel ihm ein, dass er einen der Koffer mit ins Abteil hatte nehmen wollen.

answers.answer_text: Not until he was at his friend's house did it occur to him that he had intended to take one of the suitcases with him to the compartment.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Diesen Koffer hat er gerade noch vor Abfahrt des Zuges herausbekommen.

answers.answer_text: He just got this suitcase out in time before the train left.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte Glück, es stand ein Gepäckträger da, und der hat den Koffer gleich ins Abteil gebracht.

answers.answer_text: He was lucky; there was a porter standing there, and he took the suitcase right to the compartment.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Weil der Zug schon eingelaufen war, hatte Herr Allen keine Zeit mehr sich Zeitungen zu kaufen.

answers.answer_text: Because the train had already come in, Mr. Allen no longer had time to buy any newspapers.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Müller versuchte ihm einige zu besorgen, aber als er vom Kiosk zurückkam, war der Zug schon abgefahren.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Müller tried to get him a few, but when he came back from the newsstand the train had already left.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen kam ins Hotel.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen came into the hotel.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte sich telegraphisch ein Einzelzimmer mit Bad reservieren lassen.

answers.answer_text: He had reserved a single room with bath by telegram.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Die Bestellung lag vor; man hatte ihm Zimmer 252 im zweiten Stock reserviert.

answers.answer_text: The reservation was there; they had reserved Room 252 on the third floor for him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Da er seine Frau in drei Tagen erwartete, bestellte er gleich ein Doppelzimmer.

answers.answer_text: Since he was expecting his wife in three days, he ordered a double room at the same time.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er konnte ein schönes, ruhiges Zimmer im vierten Stock bekommen.

answers.answer_text: He was able to get a nice, quiet room on the fifth floor.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Es sollte vierzig Mark kosten, zuzüglich 15 Prozent für Bedienung.

answers.answer_text: It was to cost forty marks, plus 15 per cent service charge.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen ließ sich dieses Zimmer reservieren.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen reserved this room.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dann musste er seinen Reisepass zeigen und einen Meldeschein ausfüllen.

answers.answer_text: Then he had to show his passport and fill out a registration blank.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er wollte insgesamt vierzehn Tage bleiben.

answers.answer_text: He intended to stay for two weeks altogether.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte vor, mit Reiseschecks zu bezahlen.

answers.answer_text: He was planning to pay with traveler's checks.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Der Page brachte das Gepäck auf Zimmer 252.

answers.answer_text: The bellhop took the baggage to Room 252.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen klingelte nach dem Zimmermädchen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen rang for the maid.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er bat sie, seine Anzüge aufbügeln zu lassen.

answers.answer_text: He asked her to have his suits pressed.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen stellte abends seine Schuhe vor die Zimmertür, um sie geputzt zu bekommen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen put his shoes outside the door of his room in the evening in order to get them polished.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Leider konnte ihm das Zimmermädchen keine Auskunft über Theaterkarten geben.

answers.answer_text: Unfortunately the maid could give him no information about theater tickets.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er musste sich mit dem Empfangschef in Verbindung setzen.

answers.answer_text: He had to get in touch with the desk clerk.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er rief an und bat den Empfangschef um Auskunft.

answers.answer_text: He called up and asked the desk clerk for information.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Der Empfangschef wusste, dass es im Deutschen Opernhaus "Die Zauberflöte" gab.

answers.answer_text: The desk clerk knew that the 'Magic Flute' was at the German Opera House.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen wollte eine Karte im Parkett haben.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen wanted to have a ticket in the orchestra.
